title: Rollbar Webhook Payload
description: Schema for Rollbar webhook notification payloads. All webhook events share a common structure with event_name and data top-level keys. The data content varies by event type.

event_name.description: The type of event that triggered the webhook notification.

data.description: The event data containing information about what triggered the webhook. The structure depends on the event_name.

occurrences.description: The occurrence count threshold that was crossed. Present in exp_repeat_item events (e.g., 10, 100, 1000).

rate.description: The occurrence rate that triggered the event. Present in item_velocity events.

WebhookItem.description: Item data included in webhook payloads. Contains the same data returned by the REST API Read endpoints.

environment.description: The environment where the item was seen.

title.description: The title or summary of the item.

first_occurrence_timestamp.description: Unix timestamp of the first occurrence.

last_occurrence_timestamp.description: Unix timestamp of the most recent occurrence.

WebhookOccurrence.description: Occurrence data included in webhook payloads for occurrence events.

version.description: The code version when the occurrence happened.

WebhookDeploy.description: Deploy data included in webhook payloads for deploy events.

local_username.description: The local username of the deployer.

start_time.description: Unix timestamp when the deploy started.

finish_time.description: Unix timestamp when the deploy finished.
